request: Improve this model against the drawing and the renders, following the QUALITY rules. The side view now matches well (IoU 0.86): keep the side profile. The end views got worse (front 0.885, rear 0.873; they were 0.93 / 0.91): make the body cross-sections follow end_half_width() at every height (shoulder width, how the sides tuck in at the bottom, the deck crown), and keep the windscreen frame and roll bar where the end views draw them.

kept.object: Shelby/AC Cobra open two-seat roadster, front at x=0 (drawing front on right in side/plan views, so u=1-x/LENGTH)

rounds.plan: Front on right in side/plan views (u=1-x/L). Keep the exact side-profile core+plan-prism body (side IoU 0.86), but rebuild loft cross-sections as periodic splines following end_half_width(): interpolate end_a(rear,u=0)/end_b(front,u=1) by station, bottom tuck at h=0, full shoulder width h=0.05..0.65, deck crown narrowing at h=0.70/0.75, flat tucked bottom, closing at side_top; local width/height still from half_width/side_top/side_bottom. Windscreen centred 1040/920mm wide, raked 30deg, top at HEIGHT; driver roll hoop y=-230mm, x=0.66L, top 0.92H with diagonal/rear stays. All other measured features (368mm-radius wheels at x=0.19L/0.775L, cockpit, seats, steering, scoop, grille, lights, bumpers, exhausts) retained.

rounds.plan: Front on the right in the drawn side/plan views, so measured u = 1 - x/LENGTH with x=0 at the front, y=0 on the symmetry plane, z=0 at the ground. Keep the proven side-profile body construction (cleaned side_top/side_bottom, narrow side-profile core, plan-profile prism intersect) that gave side IoU 0.86. Fix the end views with new cross-sections: a two-edge (flank/crown spline plus shallow bottom spline) convex wire per station whose half-width at every height z is half_width(u) scaled by end_half_width(z/HEIGHT) interpolated between end_a (rear) and end_b (front) and normalised at h/H=0.50, giving the measured full shoulder width, bottom tuck and deck crown; loft ruled=False through 37 stations. Keep the windscreen frame/glass (1040/920mm, raked 30deg, top at HEIGHT, base x=0.44L) and the driver roll hoop (centred y=-230mm, x=0.66L, top 0.92H) where the end views draw them, but rebuild the roll bar purely from overlapping cylinders so it is a valid solid (the torus-plus-cut version was invalid and the periodic-spline loft fragmented the body). All other measured parts retained: 368mm-radius wheels at x=0.19L/0.775L with ring tyres, rim rings, hubs, spokes and brake discs; cockpit cut with floor, dashboard, two leather seats, steering wheel and gear lever; bonnet scoop and intake, fuel cap, oval grille, 196/172mm headlights, indicators, tail lights, side vents, door handles, cowl mirror, front bumper, rear overriders and side exhausts.

Keep the proven round-1 side profile and closed periodic-spline body loft (side IoU 0.86). Fix the round-2 failure: the two-edge open-spline loft produced an invalid/null solid that broke the cockpit cut, so return to valid closed sections but scale each section point's width by end_half_width(z/HEIGHT) interpolated between end_a (rear) and end_b (front) by station, giving the measured shoulder width, bottom tuck and deck crown at every height. Keep windscreen (1040/920mm, raked 30deg at x=0.44L, top near HEIGHT) and the cylinder-only driver roll hoop (x=0.66L, y=-230mm, top ~1104mm) where the end views draw them. Guard every body boolean (core union, plan intersect, wheel-arch and cockpit cuts) with validity/volume checks and fallback to the last good solid so no Null shape propagates. All other parts (wheels, cockpit interior, scoop, grille, lights, bumpers, exhausts, mirror) unchanged from the valid round-1 model.

Body loft rebuilt with end_half_width-shaped cross-sections (shoulder, bottom tuck, deck crown at every height) and a raised flat underbody centre with low outer skirts, so side/top silhouettes are kept while front/rear projections lose the solid slab between the wheels; central side core replaced by two outer side cores. Windscreen widened to the end-view width and raked 35deg, roll bar moved to x=0.71L at spike height with the drawn forward diagonal brace, mirror tucked inboard. All other proven parts (wheels, cockpit, seats, lights, grille, bumpers, exhausts) kept.
